question: Which of the following is an indigenous dairy breed of cattle?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Red Sindhi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Red Sindhi is a reputed heat-tolerant indigenous dairy cattle breed originating from the Sindh province of Pakistan.**
 
• The **breed is also known as “Malir”, “Red Karachi” and “Sindhi”. **
 
• It is considered that breed evolved from Las Bela cattle of Bela, Baluchistan. 
 
• The breed is of** distinct red colour and darker than Sahiwal.**
 
• The **milk yield** of the cattle ranges from** 2000 to 4000 kg per lactation with an average yield of 1840 kg per lactation.**
 
• Fat percentage in the milk varies from 4 to 5.2% with an average of 4.5%. 
 
• Among the** indigenous cattle breeds are Sahiwal, Red Sindhi, Gir, Tharparkar, etc.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​Chippiparai, Kanni, and Kombai **are breeds of sighthound dogs native to Southern India.
 
• Traditionally **kept for hunting.**
